description: This file contains JavaScript functions for debugging, rendering information, and interacting with TinyMCE editor instances within a web application. It includes functions for logging, toggling UI elements, rendering browser and editor info, and managing selections.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the debugging interface, loads logs, and sets log filter value.

methods.name: changeFilter
methods.description: Changes the log filter used for debugging output.

methods.name: toggleFlip
methods.description: Toggles the flip state of a UI element and updates its appearance.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs a debug message to the log if logging is enabled and the message matches the filter.

methods.name: renderInfo
methods.description: Renders detailed browser, TinyMCE engine, and editor instance information into the page.

methods.name: addRenderInfo
methods.description: Helper function to format and add a row of information for rendering.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Displays the settings of all TinyMCE instances.

methods.name: renderContent
methods.description: Displays the content of all TinyMCE instances.

methods.name: renderCommandStates
methods.description: Displays the command states for TinyMCE instances.

methods.name: renderUndoRedo
methods.description: Displays undo/redo history for TinyMCE instances.

methods.name: restoreSelection
methods.description: Restores the selection from the stored bookmark.
